title: Time Zones: Friendly Names Instead of Hundreds of Technical Ones | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Every date and time on your site is shown in some time zone, and Orchard Core normally offers hundreds of technical names to choose from, such as America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires. The CrestApps Time Zones feature replaces that list with the short list of friendly names you control, such as Eastern Time (US & Canada), and every time zone menu on the site follows it.

In this video:
• Why friendly time zone names help
• What a time zone map is, and which menus use the list
• Browsing the list, adding a map, and changing or removing one
• Setting the site's default time zone
• Letting each person choose their own time zone
• Four ways to use it

chapters.title: Let each person use their own
